channel.title: History Slop
channel.description: Hour-long two-host deep dives into contested questions in military, medieval and Asian history, built from real scholarship (including non-English research) and voiced by two synthetic hosts who know exactly what they are and occasionally apologise for their pronunciation. Every episode links its script and sources, so you can check the machine's homework.
